9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:32220c7f-c577.title: Field Applications Engineer
9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:32220c7f-c577.description: Location: Onsite — Austin, TX Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time Job Title: Field Applications Engineer About 9 Mothers The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. Why 9 Mothers? While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. Position Summary We are seeking a Field Applications Engineer (Demo Engineer) to serve as the critical bridge between our engineering lab and real-world deployment. You will be the hands-on expert responsible for bringing our autonomous c-sUAS platforms to life in front of active-duty end users, government partners, and key stakeholders. From flashing software builds and calibrating multi-sensor payloads in the lab to operating systems and troubleshooting hardware live on the test range, you ensure zero-fail execution when the pressure is on. Essential Duties - Demo Operations & Execution: Lead live, dynamic flight and target-tracking demonstrations in field environments, operating autonomous counter-drone systems flawlessly under high-stakes conditions. - System Preparation & Hardware Setup: Prepare, assemble, and check complex autonomous hardware and edge-compute systems prior to field tests and customer demonstrations. - On-Site & Field Calibration: Perform precise hardware and sensor alignment, including boresighting, thermal/EO camera focusing, lens calibration, and multi-sensor orientation. - Software Deployment & Validation: Flash latest software builds, test system stability, perform integration tests, and ensure firmware/software readiness for field trials. - Rapid Field Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve unexpected hardware, software, networking, and sensor issues on the fly with minimal downtime during field trials. - Feedback Loop: Serve as the direct link between field reality and R&D, capturing detailed telemetry, edge cases, and user feedback to inform engineering rapid iteration cycles. - Linux Shell & Networking: Highly comfortable working in a Linux shell environment with a strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing, and system diagnostics. Requirements - Hands-on Field/Demo Experience: Demonstrated experience deploying, operating, or troubleshooting complex hardware/software systems in real-world or live-fire test range environments. - Technical Calibration Skills: Practical experience with optical/camera calibration (focus, boresighting), sensor alignment, and field validation techniques. - System Administration & Tooling: Proficient in Linux CLI environments, firmware/software flashing tools, and basic networking/telemetry debugging. - Hardware & Electronics Proficiency: Experience with harness assembly, field repair, cable building, and multimeters/oscilloscopes for quick edge-side hardware fixes. - Travel & Physical Requirements: Willingness to travel to outdoor testing sites and demonstration ranges; comfortable working outdoors in varying terrain and weather conditions. - Compliance: This position requires access to export-controlled information under ITAR. Only U.S. citizens are permitted. Must be willing to submit a background check. Nice-to-Have - Prior experience with robotics, Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS), counter-UAS (c-UAS), or defense range operations. - Familiarity with thermal/IR optics, RF sensors, or embedded Linux environm

aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:866.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Communications Associate will assist the LA Kings’ Hockey Communications Staff with game-day duties, including press setup, credentialing, postgame notes and other media servicing duties as assigned. Essential Functions Assist the Communications Department with game day duties in preparation for members of the media, scouts, league personnel and team staff, including setting up the Bob Miller Press Box and Chick Hearn Press Room, printing materials for in-game use, seating chart distribution, and interview support. Assist Hockey Communications Staff in compiling in-game and postgame notes. Associates will do so using various statistical-based recourses provided by the team, including NHL.com/stats, EliteProspects.com, StatHead.com, StatMuse.com and more. In doing so, associates will learn and master the process involved in writing stat-based hockey information, player section notes and game notes for upcoming games. Ensure the single gameday credential window through Media Will Call at Crypto.com Arena’s Box Office is opened 2.5 hours prior to puck drop and that all credentials are distributed to the appropriate personnel, including but not limited to media, scouts, guests, league personnel, etc. Following the game, associates will be involved in helping set up all post-game interviews and gather audio from both home and visiting dressing rooms to be distributed to members of the media and posted on the team’s media-only website, LAKings.com/media. Associates may be subject to interactions with players and executives of the LA Kings, visiting team personnel, league officials and local and national media outlets. Candidates will be expected to act in a professional manner at all times. The ideal candidates will be expected to have availability working two out of every three homes games. There will be 15-20 hours of gameday time per week as needed, depending on the team’s schedule. Other duties as assigned, with potential for in-office hours and projects as assigned. Specific Job Knowledge, Skill, and Ability The Communications Associate must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skill and abilities: Ideal candidates should be proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, InDesign and Illustrator and in Microsoft Office, including Work, Excel and Outlook. Ability to multi-task in fast-paced environment. Work effectively under deadlines. High degree of organizational skills. Strong hockey knowledge and interest in other team sports a plus. Qualification Standards Education: High School Diploma of its equivalency Experience: A minimum of 0-1 years of related professional work or internship experience. agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.title: Investment Banking Analyst
agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.description: Our Firm Agentis Capital Advisors is a leading global financial advisor with a reputation for delivering unparalleled value and advice to its clients. The firm has been the recipient of numerous industry rewards in recent years, including 2024 P3 Awards Financial Advisor of the Year, multiple 2023 industry deal awards, Proximo Infra's 2022 North American Financial Advisor of the Year, and IJGlobal's 2022 Judge's Choice Award. Our guiding principles and ability to generate value for clients sets us apart. Agentis acts as a sell-side and buy-side advisor on a wide variety of global transactions including renewable power, energy, digital, transportation, and public-private partnerships. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, contractors, and governments. Agentis Capital Advisors is a business segment of Agentis Capital Partners, which operates a synergistic platform across four main business segments: Agentis Capital Partners (principal investments), Agentis Capital Advisors (financial advisory and asset management services), Agentis Capital Mining Partners (mining advisory), and Agentis Capital Markets (capital markets). The Opportunity Our analyst program is designed to cultivate the quantitative and qualitative skills necessary to excel in an investment banking career and as a future executive. You will receive both formal and on-the-job training throughout your tenure. You will gain increasing levels of responsibility as you progress in your career, from building financial models, to managing multiple deal workstreams, to leading client relationships. You will be given unparalleled exposure and opportunities, including the chance to work on numerous transactions at the start of your career, with the only constraint on your role being your own capacity, rather than your rank level. As a result, our team members achieve accelerated career growth. You will be recognized and rewarded for your individual performance within a close-knit team and meritocratic culture. The only constraint on your role, responsibilities, and compensation will be your own performance. This is a 1-year contract position with the potential for renewal, based on performance. Compensation will include a competitive base salary in USD and a performance-based bonus. Your Contribution As an integral member of the advisory team, you will be challenged to accept increasing levels of responsibility as you develop your skills and reputation. Your work will directly impact our clients and the firm. Your role will include: - Participating in the execution of equity and debt offerings, mergers and acquisitions, public-private partnerships, and principal investments - Developing complex financial models for infrastructure transactions, including the use of macros and VBA programming - Assisting in the management of due diligence processes, including managing third-party advisors - Developing asset valuations using a variety of approaches - Preparing client presentations and actively participating in discussions - Evaluating investment opportunities and management of existing investments - Researching potential investment banking opportunities; providing research on target companies, sectors, industries, and geographies - Maintaining marketing materials for the firm, including creating pitch decks to be presented to potential clients As a member of a high-performing team working in a fast-paced environment, there will be times where you will be required to work beyond a normal workday or workweek to fulfill the responsibilities of the role. Our Differentiators Breadth of experience and level of responsibility - Exceptional level of responsibility on complex transactions - Wide breadth of work across verticals, financial products and principal opportunities - Opportunities to work on large global transactions - Secondment opportunities within Agentis portfolio companies Training - Continuous internal training program - Internal leadership deve

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:a3ac1eba-.title: Principal Product Manager - MoneyLion Marketplace
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:a3ac1eba-.description: ABOUT GEN: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Marketplace is where MoneyLion customers see their financial options and act on them. It brings together MoneyLion's own money tools and a wide range of partner products, and customers count on us for the full picture and a clear sense of what actually fits their situation. We care a lot about the trust customers extend to us, and about turning it into long-term relationships that grow with them as their financial lives change. As Principal Product Manager, you'll take on the hardest, highest-stakes problems in the Marketplace, including the cross-cutting ones that shape where it heads and that no single team fully owns today. You'll set direction in your area and influence it well beyond, working through other teams as much as with your own. This is a hands-on role — you'll be in the details with your team day to day, not directing from a distance. The space is moving quickly, so reading customer and market signal and turning it into the bets we make next is a core part of the job. You'll report to the Director of Product. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: · Own the most complex, cross-cutting problems in the Marketplace from problem to launch to iteration, and be accountable for how they move customer and business outcomes. · Set the strategy and roadmap for your area, and make the case for the bets worth making. · Take on ambiguous problems before they're well defined. Frame them so other teams can move in parallel, and set the direction they build against. · Work closely with design, engineering, and data science to ship, and partner with research and analytics to understand what customers actually do. · Build buy-in across the company, and collaborate with partners and adjacent teams (covering both B2C and B2B). · Raise the bar for product craft around you. · Use experimentation to learn quickly and iterate. · Have a real point of view on where AI belongs in the Marketplace, from more personal and timely guidance to experiences customers trust with their money. · Use AI as a teammate in your day-to-day to raise product quality and team speed. ABOUT YOU: Experience: · 8+ years of product management experience, including consumer apps, with a track record of taking hard, ambiguous problems from unclear to shipped and scaled. What you'll bring: · A strong feel for UX and what "good" is for consumers, and the judgment to push for it. · Fluency with data. You use it to find problems, size opportunities, and decide, and you know when the numbers aren't enough. · An experimentation mindset. southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:4d2e81.title: Product Manager, Growth Platform
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:4d2e81.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. We are hiring a Product Manager, Growth Platform to own our marketing website end-to-end. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a high-impact, high-ownership position for someone who treats the website as a revenue asset, obsesses over craft and design, and is determined to make it the best in the industry. You'll sit at the intersection of marketing, design, and engineering, and you'll be the person who keeps our web experience sharp, fast, and converting. If you're the kind of person who bookmarks great websites, thinks in conversion funnels, and loses sleep over a CTA that isn't performing, this is your role. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the marketing website end-to-end as a pipeline and conversion asset, including CMS, architecture, and performance - Work with the marketing team to enable them to build out template pages and be content owners - Define and maintain conversion paths and customer journeys across the site, from first touch to webinar to demo request - Run a continuous testing and optimization program (A/B, multivariate) to improve conversion rates across key pages and CTAs - Partner with PMM to ensure messaging, positioning, and content are accurately reflected across the site and updated with each launch - Partner with design to brief, review, and ship new page designs and site updates, serving as the marketing-side owner in the creative process - Manage the relationship with engineering to scope, prioritize, and QA web development work - Own and maintain the marketing web roadmap and backlog; run sprint or project cycles to keep work moving - Establish and report on web KPIs: traffic-to-MQL conversion, page engagement, demo request rate, and more - Constantly scour the web for great websites and make our website an excellent resource for prospects and customers WHO YOU ARE - 4+ years in a web product, growth, or digital marketing role - Strong design sensibility and obsessive attention to craft; you have a point of view on what makes a great website, you can articulate it, and you hold every page and interaction to that standard - Hands-on experience with CMS platforms, A/B testing tools, and web analytics - Comfortable working across marketing, design, and engineering without losing momentum - Highly organized with a bias toward shipping; you run a tight backlog and keep projects moving - Obsessive about conversion and deeply curious about what makes buyers take action LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $180,000 to $250,000, depending on experience. Profound's total compensation package includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. #LI-PRO Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone
